phase: Phase 06 UI Few-Shot Curation / Prompt Preparation

filters: exclude interaction-tagged entries when target interaction_tags are empty
exclude exception-tagged entries when target exception_tags are empty
ranking_notes: prefer local_repo controls when other tags match
prefer lower selection_rank after score tie

source.purpose: Repo-local page shell and routing control baseline.

entries.why_it_matches: Page shell with source-aligned routing, helper extraction, and page-owned composition without invented controller shells.
prompt_hints: Preserve page and router semantics 1:1.
Allow source-aligned helper rendering methods without flattening them away.
Do not invent extra providers or view models when the page already owns short-lived UI state.

source.purpose: Repo-local persistence and manager-owned state control baseline.

entries.why_it_matches: Page shell where manager/controller remains the durable truth owner and UI only mirrors display state.
prompt_hints: Keep controller or manager as the single durable truth owner.
Allow lifecycle hooks to sync UI from external state.
Do not absorb persistence or repair logic into the page contract.

entries.why_it_matches: Page shell using source-aligned local state with child components consuming linked props rather than hidden stores.
prompt_hints: Preserve parent page state and child component boundaries.
Let reusable child components consume props or links instead of becoming pages.
Keep list/grid composition explicit.

source.purpose: Primary page decomposition and reusable component extraction baseline.

entries.why_it_matches: Entry page coordinating multiple reusable render blocks while keeping composition responsibilities in the page shell.
prompt_hints: Page shell may orchestrate multiple source-aligned child builders or components.
Keep reusable layout blocks split instead of collapsing into one mega build body.
Do not rewrite render-model style state holders into invented services.

entries.why_it_matches: Page shell with builder-layered modal content and explicit page-owned presentation state.
prompt_hints: Keep builder layers explicit when the source already uses them.
Treat modal presentation state as page-local UI state, not controller truth.
Do not flatten mixed-app samples into a single invented runtime shell.

source.purpose: Custom tab bar and controller-owned UI state baseline.

entries.why_it_matches: Page shell using a controller plus provide/link state flow, keeping durable tab truth outside child render blocks.
prompt_hints: Keep controller-owned state singular across page and child tab components.
Allow @Provide/@Link propagation without inventing extra stores.
Do not collapse tab child components back into the page body.

entries.why_it_matches: Rich reusable component with substantial render logic while durable parsing and configuration truth stays outside the component contract.
prompt_hints: Preserve reusable component boundaries even when build logic is large.
Do not promote component internals to page or router ownership.
Keep controller/configuration truth outside transient render state.

entries.why_it_matches: Gesture-heavy reusable component where interaction state stays with a model/controller and does not leak page responsibilities.
prompt_hints: Preserve gesture thresholds, callback order, and animation boundaries.
Keep interaction state attached to the component model/controller.
Do not move network or persistence work into gesture handlers.

entries.why_it_matches: Reusable renderer component that consumes a model and rendering context without becoming a page shell or controller owner.
prompt_hints: Keep renderer-oriented reusable component boundaries intact.
Allow builders and render contexts without promoting page ownership.
Do not invent extra service or router layers around a renderer component.
